title: Rate limit will kill the process
body: ### Describe the bug If we get an `openai.error.RateLimitError: Rate limit reached` error the process will halt. I consider this a bug because it was described as fixed as part of #46 ### Reproduce - Make a new account with openAI - Start using the interpreter with lots of recurring challenges (edit x and try to run until there are no errors) ### Expected behavior The program pauses for a bit of time, informs me that it hit a rate limit, and then it tries again shortly after so a rate limit does not stop the current flow being processed. ### Screenshots ### Open Interpreter version 0.1.4 ### Python version 3.11.5 ### Operating System name and version Mac 12.6 ### Additional context This can be dealt with in interpreter/interpreter.py", line 621 by wrapping in a loop or try catch that deals with rerunning the request after a few seconds if (and only) an exception is based on a rate limit

linked_prs.title: Retry connecting to openai after hitting rate limit to fix #442

diff --git a/tests/test_rate_limit_retry.py b/tests/test_rate_limit_retry.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e69de29
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_rate_limit_retry.py
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+import pytest
+import time
+from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
+from interpreter import interpreter
+from openai.error import RateLimitError
+
+class DummyInterpreter(interpreter.Interpreter):
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.call_count = 0
+
+    def _mock_llm_call(self):
+        self.call_count += 1
+        if self.call_count < 3:
+            raise RateLimitError("Rate limit reached")
+        return "Success"
+
+@patch('interpreter.interpreter.time.sleep', return_value=None)
+def test_respond_retries_on_rate_limit(mock_sleep):
+    dummy = DummyInterpreter()
+    # Patch the respond method's LLM call to our dummy method
+    original_respond = dummy.respond
+
+    def patched_respond():
+        max_attempts = 3
+        attempts = 0
+        while attempts < max_attempts:
+            attempts += 1
+            try:
+                return dummy._mock_llm_call()
+            except RateLimitError:
+                time.sleep(attempts)
+                max_attempts += 1
+        pytest.fail("Should have succeeded before max attempts")
+
+    dummy.respond = patched_respond
+    result = dummy.respond()
+    assert result == "Success"
+    assert dummy.call_count == 3
+    assert mock_sleep.call_count == 2
